pontos: Amends Law 14.148/2021, which created Perse, a program for the resumption of the events sector
PIS/Pasep and Cofins rate set to zero for revenue from regular passenger air transport
Reduces PIS/Pasep and Cofins on diesel, biodiesel, LPG, alcohol, aviation kerosene, vehicular natural gas and gasoline
Excludes ICMS from the calculation base of PIS/Pasep and Cofins credits
